newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turks told to turn off lights to illuminate scandal.
newsitem.headline: Turks told to turn off lights to illuminate scandal.

text.p: Turks plan to plunge their country into darkness to throw some light on a government scandal.

Engin Cin, an organiser of a campaign entitled "A minute's darkness for eternal light", says they want Turks to turn off all their lights for a minute at 1900 GMT each day for a month starting on Saturday.

The protest aims to press the government to resolve the scandal stemming from a crash on November 3 when a top policeman and a wanted gangster died in the same car. A government MP in the same car was injured.
An investigation into state ties to the underworld has produced no results, but the media has carried an increasing number of claims that the state is infiltrated by crime gangs.
"Those who investigate the scandal need support," Cin told Reuters on Friday. "The potential support lies in us, the citizens, in those who do not want to live in a state full of gangs."
